signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Elite pass rushers are a mix of strength, speed, and tenacity. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their win rate and block shed speed against one-on-one pass blocks.
Defenders with this ability can still tackle effectively while trying to strip the football.
Defenders with this ability will receive dominant bull rush wins when their pass rush points are full
Defenders with this ability use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the edge of the defense.
Defenders with this ability will grant a bonus pass rush point to all defensive linemen on any 3rd or 4th down
Momentum Shift players demoralize their opponents. When they enter the zone, all on field opponents are knocked out of the zone or lose any progress towards entering the zone.
Defenders with this ability will receive dominant bull rush wins when their pass rush points are full
Defenders with this ability can apply pressure to the quarterback from a greater distance.
Defenders with this ability use faster run shed moves for a better chance at shedding blocks within 5 yards of the goal line.
Defenders with this ability use faster; more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the interior of the defensive line.
Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move.
Blockers with this ability reduce an edge pass rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move
Blockers with this ability will dominantly win impact blocks on screen plays
Blockers with this ability will frequently attempt and win pull blocks
Blockers with this ability will frequently attempt and win impact blocks against linebackers and defensive backs when playing as a lineman or fullback.
Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move.
Some players thrive on making defenders look silly. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their fakeout rate on the next juke, spin or hurdle.
Ballcarriers with this ability retain more of their forward momentum during tackles while travelling at high speeds.
After securing a RAC catch, ballcarriers with this ability can quickly shift momentum, change direction, and turn the corner without sacrificing speed.
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke and spin animations.
Blockers with this ability will frequently attempt and win impact blocks against linebackers and defensive backs when playing as a lineman or fullback.
Blockers with this ability are almost guaranteed to win any double team block they are engaged in
Passers with this ability improve the catching prowess of all tight ends who are open on pass plays.
